studies.title: The peanut
studies.caption: Peanuts flower above the soil, then develop their pods below it. A lifted plant reveals why the harvest comes from the ground rather than the leafy branches.
studies.prompt: Botanical study of a freshly lifted Arachis hypogaea plant on loose soil, low stems with paired four-leaflet leaves and a few small yellow flowers; thin pegs lead to modest peanut pods clustered at roots, one split pod nearby. No pods on above-ground branches, no tree, no diagram arrows.
